subject: math
description: Relate exterior angles to adjacent interior angles in polygons, then write and solve angle equations.
learningObjectives: Identify an interior angle and its adjacent exterior angle
Explain why an exterior angle and its adjacent interior angle form a linear pair
Write equations involving exterior and adjacent interior angles
Solve for missing interior or exterior angle measures
prerequisites: Recognize sides, vertices, and angles of polygons
Know that a straight angle measures 180 degrees
Solve one-step addition and subtraction equations
